summary: Generated Stage Gate source is not tracked in Git; CI and local runs regenerate it from templates, JSON and manifests into a generation root outside the repository checkout.
rationale: User answer to Plan 06 D3. Tracked generated/stages copies duplicate profile JSON and invite drift. Generating inside the repository would inherit root Central Package Management (NU1008) and expose builds to head-controlled MSBuild discovery, so the generation root is outside both head and base worktrees. Implemented in P7.2-P7.4. Plan 06 section 17 D3; review R7 and sections 6.6, 11.4 and 12.3.
